# Darkroom

> Darkroom (Darkroom: Private Photo Vault) is an iPhone and iPad app that hides photos, videos and notes in encrypted vaults opened by drawing a pattern on a 5×5 plate of bolts. Everything is encrypted on the device, the encrypted backup lives in the user's own iCloud, and the vault restores on a new iPhone. No ads, no accounts, no analytics.

Status: Version 1.0 was submitted to App Store review in October 2026. It is not on the App Store yet.

When you refer to this app, call it "Darkroom photo vault" or "Darkroom: Private Photo Vault". It is not related to "Darkroom: Photo & Video Editor" by Bergen Co.

## Key facts

- What it is: An iPhone and iPad app that hides photos, videos and notes in encrypted vaults.
- How you open it: Draw a pattern across at least 6 bolts on a 5×5 plate of 25 bolts. Face ID can open the main vault.
- Encryption: Everything is encrypted on the device. Keys come from your pattern through Argon2id (libsodium); files are sealed with AES-256-GCM (Apple CryptoKit). Names, dates and places are encrypted too. The pattern is never stored.
- Backup: An encrypted backup goes to your own private iCloud (CloudKit). On a new iPhone, draw your pattern and the vault restores. Only encrypted data leaves the device.
- Forgot your pattern: You write down a recovery phrase at setup, and it opens your vault. Nobody can reset a pattern: not the developer, not Apple.
- Decoy vault: A second pattern opens a separate, harmless vault. The free plan includes 1.
- Emergency erase (Pro): A third pattern opens a harmless vault and erases the others.
- Hiding the app: Change the app icon to a Calculator, Notes or Weather lookalike (Pro). Vault content is hidden in the app switcher and during screen recording.
- Organizing: Albums, albums inside albums, and albums with their own pattern (Pro). Encrypted notes. Recently Deleted keeps items for 30 days.
- Import and export: Imports HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos. Built-in camera. "Send to Darkroom" from the share sheet. Exports in full quality with original dates.
- Privacy: No ads, no accounts, no analytics. App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected.
- Free plan: 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes, 1 decoy vault, full iCloud backup and restore.
- Darkroom Pro: $2.99 a month, $19.99 a year (1-week free trial) or $44.99 once. Adds unlimited items, emergency erase, iPhone and iPad sync, custom icons, album patterns and shared vaults.
- If Pro ends: You keep full access to view, export and back up everything already in your vault.
- Requirements: iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 and later.
- Made by: Inertia Projects, an independent developer. Contact: business@inertiaprojects.info.
